items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: I played, I played a job with Bunk Johnson and George Lewis.

ctx.x: Well then I played around the city. I played with D.D. and Billy a while, and Ernest Rogers, and I played with, that was during the WPA time. I played, I played a job with Bunk Johnson and George Lewis.

Well I remember hearing down the country violin. Yeah. I remember later Bunk said he'd like for you to be, wish you could have gone to New York and played with him once. Yeah. So you told me that one time. He'd like to use you on clarinet.
